$comment: Variables of the LumiBase service in the Railway template (#741). Railway templates are composed in Railway's template editor, not read from the repository; this file is the reviewed source a maintainer copies them from, and scripts/__tests__/deploy-manifests.test.mjs keeps it honest. Postgres and Redis are Railway's official database services named `Postgres` and `Redis`. Service source: Docker image ghcr.io/khuepm/lumibase-cms:<version> -- a release tag, never latest: the image migrates the database on every start, so latest turns a restart after a major release into an unattended upgrade. (railway.json is for services created from the repository and builds from source instead.) Enable a public domain on the service: CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS is deliberately not set here, the entrypoint derives it from RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN, and a template value such as https://${{RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN}} would expand to https:// without a domain. ENCRYPTION_KEY is a standard, padded base64 AES-256 key the server accepts as-is; the entrypoint never rewrites it.
